# Rasa-e-Lazzat

> Halal Pakistani home kitchen in Kuala Lumpur. Sophie cooks. Order on WhatsApp.

- Canonical site: https://razzat.vercel.app/
- Kitchen lead: Sophie
- Slogan: The Taste of Home in Every Bite
- Diet: Halal kitchen. Chicken is halal. Pickle is vegan. Dahi baray and Shahi Tukray are vegetarian (dairy).
- Service area: Kuala Lumpur and Greater Klang Valley (Selangor)
- Order: WhatsApp +60 176020325 — https://wa.me/60176020325
- Lineage: 1920s Allahabad spice trade → Pakistan → Saudi Arabia → Kuala Lumpur 2026 (100+ years of family recipes; the KL kitchen opened 2026)
- Full source: https://razzat.vercel.app/llms-full.txt

## Menu (MYR)

Prices in Malaysian Ringgit. Approximate nutrition; home-style portions may vary.

1. Authentic Chicken Biryani — RM 15 (was RM 32). Complimentary yogurt raita. Halal. Not vegan. Contains meat. Allergens: milk (raita); may contain gluten; mustard. About 750 kcal per plate; raita about 70 kcal extra.
2. Chicken Dumplings (12 pieces) — RM 22. Steamed chicken momo with mint-chilli chutney. Halal. Not vegan. Allergens: gluten (wheat wrappers); may contain soy or sesame in the chutney. No dairy in the dumpling. About 520 kcal for 12 pieces.
3. Shahi Tukray — RM 16. Best seller. Halal, vegetarian, not vegan. Allergens: gluten (bread), milk, possible nuts (pistachio/almond). About 480 kcal per portion.
4. Royal Shahi Dahi Baray — RM 18. Halal, vegetarian, not vegan. Allergens: milk; may contain gluten (fritters often gram/chickpea flour). About 400 kcal per bowl.
5. Sophie's Chilli Pickle (Mirch Ka Achar) — RM 28. Halal, vegan, vegetarian. Condiment, not a meal, not a medical food. Allergens: mustard; possible traces of sesame/nuts (shared home kitchen). About 50 kcal per 1 tablespoon.

Shared kitchen: dairy, gluten, nuts, sesame, mustard. Traces possible.

## Gifts — Biryani is Love extras

Charm, rose, or flowers with biryani for Hari Raya, Chinese New Year, birthday, anniversary, thank-you. Rasa-e-Lazzat only. Kraft wrap, saffron ribbon, occasion sticker — festive wrap, no partner card.

1. Charm — RM 18. Keepsake, not food.
2. Single rose — RM 10.
3. Small bouquet — RM 30.

Add extras on their own or with Authentic Chicken Biryani (RM 15, raita included). Section: https://razzat.vercel.app/#gifts

## Meal plans

No bread, roti, or naan in the boxes. Dishes may vary with the week’s cooking. Pickup or delivery, KL and Greater Klang Valley. Section: https://razzat.vercel.app/#meal-plan

1. Weekly Salan Box — RM 110 / week. Seven single-serve homemade salan in disposable boxes. Sample: Chicken Aloo, Chana Masala, Chicken White Karahi, Bhindi Salan, Tadka Daal, Chicken Nihari, Chicken Qorma.
2. Lunch Plan — Monday to Friday. Weekly RM 70 · Monthly RM 280. Sample: Qeema Aloo, Qeema Matar, Palak Chicken, Aloo Ghosht, rice with chicken or beef, mix sabzi, daal.
3. Dinner Plan — Monday to Friday. Weekly RM 85 · Monthly RM 340. Sample: Chicken sizzling, Aloo Ghosht, beef salan, Palak chicken, Chicken karahi, mix sabzi, daal with rice.

## How to order

Add dishes on https://razzat.vercel.app/#menu, extras on https://razzat.vercel.app/#gifts, or a meal plan on https://razzat.vercel.app/#meal-plan, then checkout via WhatsApp, or message +60 176020325 directly.
